title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Overview


We are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to join our technology team and play a key role in building, automating, and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure technology environments.


The successful candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in **DevOps, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, automation, monitoring, and security**. The role requires someone who can work across development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams and take ownership of solutions from inception through deployment and ongoing production support.


The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in modern **cloud\-native and microservices environments**, with practical experience using tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Service Mesh, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK**.


Key Responsibilities


DevOps \& Automation* Implement and maintain DevOps practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle.
* Automate deployment, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.
* Develop reusable automation solutions to improve deployment speed, consistency, reliability, and scalability.
* Identify manual and repetitive operational activities and convert them into automated workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of development and operational processes.


CI/CD \& Release Management* Design, develop, implement, and maintain robust **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Build and maintain Jenkins\-based Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment pipelines.
* Develop and maintain **Jenkins Shared Libraries and Pipeline\-as\-Code** solutions.
* Develop automation scripts using **Groovy, Python, Bash**, or other appropriate scripting technologies.
* Implement and maintain **GitHub Actions** workflows for build, testing, deployment, and automation.
* Support automated application deployments across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues and implement permanent solutions.
* Improve release processes through automation, standardization, and continuous delivery practices.


Kubernetes \& Container Technologies* Deploy, configure, manage, and troubleshoot containerized applications.
* Work extensively with **Native Kubernetes and/or OpenShift** environments.
* Support application deployment and management across container platforms.
* Work with Kubernetes\-based workloads, services, configurations, secrets, and deployment mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot container, networking, deployment, and runtime issues.
* Support highly available and scalable containerized environments.
* Work with cloud\-native and microservices\-based architectures.


Cloud Infrastructure* Design, deploy, manage, and support infrastructure across public cloud environments.
* Work with at least one major public cloud platform such as:
* + **Microsoft Azure**
	+ **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**
	+ **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
* Implement cloud infrastructure following security, scalability, availability, and performance best practices.
* Support cloud migration, deployment, configuration, and operational activities.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and application\-related issues.


Infrastructure as Code \& Configuration Management* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**.
* Automate configuration management and application/infrastructure provisioning using **Ansible**.
* Create reusable and standardized infrastructure deployment processes.
* Manage multiple environments using automated and version\-controlled infrastructure configurations.
* Ensure infrastructure changes follow appropriate governance, security, and change\-management practices.


GitOps* Implement and support **GitOps\-based deployment practices**.
* Work with tools such as **ArgoCD** to automate application deployments and environment synchronization.
* Maintain deployment configurations and application manifests through version\-controlled repositories.
* Troubleshoot synchronization and deployment issues within GitOps environments.


Service Mesh \& Microservices* Provide hands\-on support for **Service Mesh technologies** in cloud\-native environments.
* Understand communication patterns between microservices and troubleshoot service\-to\-service connectivity issues.
* Support traffic management, service discovery, security, and observability within microservices environments.
* Work with authentication and authorization mechanisms for microservices.
* Support secure communication between distributed services.


Security \& Authentication* Apply strong infrastructure and application security practices across DevOps environments.
* Understand microservice **authentication and authorization** processes.
* Demonstrate knowledge of **OAuth 2\.0** standards and their practical implementation.
* Support secure API communication and service\-to\-service authentication.
* Work closely with security and infrastructure teams to identify and mitigate potential risks.
* Ensure security considerations are incorporated into CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application deployments.


Monitoring, Logging \& Observability* Implement and maintain application and infrastructure monitoring solutions.
* Work with monitoring and observability technologies such as:
* + **Prometheus**
	+ **Grafana**
	+ **ELK Stack**
* Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and monitoring mechanisms.
* Analyze logs and metrics to identify performance, availability, and reliability issues.
* Support proactive monitoring and incident detection.
* Contribute to improving system observability and operational reliability.


API \& Integration* Demonstrate understanding of **REST and SOAP APIs**.
* Work with API consumers and publishers.
* Develop or configure integrations with external and internal APIs.
* Troubleshoot API connectivity, authentication, and communication issues.
* Apply appropriate security standards when integrating APIs and microservices.


Production Support \& Troubleshooting* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, application, deployment, and environment\-related issues.
* Work closely with development and operations teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Participate in incident resolution and production support activities.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Support applications and infrastructure throughout their complete lifecycle.
* Maintain reliability and availability of production environments.


Project Delivery* Take ownership of technical activities from **project inception through implementation, deployment, and production support**.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, infrastructure engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to technical design and solution implementation.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines, quality standards, and technical requirements.
* Provide operational support after project implementation.


Required Technical Skills


The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in several of the following areas:

**DevOps \& CI/CD**

* DevOps methodology
* CI/CD
* Jenkins
* Jenkins Shared Libraries
* Pipeline\-as\-Code
* Groovy
* Python
* GitHub Actions

**Container \& Cloud Native**

* Kubernetes
* OpenShift
* Docker / Container technologies
* Service Mesh
* Microservices

**Infrastructure Automation**

* Terraform
* Ansible
* Infrastructure as Code
* Configuration Management

**Cloud**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* OCI

**GitOps**

* ArgoCD
* Git\-based deployment practices

**Monitoring \& Logging**

* ELK
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* Application and infrastructure monitoring

**Security \& Integration**

* OAuth 2\.0
* Microservices authentication and authorization
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Infrastructure security


DevOps / SRE Knowledge


The candidate should have a comprehensive understanding of:

* DevOps principles and methodologies
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Infrastructure as Code
* Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery
* GitOps
* Cloud\-native application architecture
* Microservices
* 12\-Factor Application principles
* Automation and configuration management
* Production reliability and availability
* Monitoring, logging, and observability
* Incident management and troubleshooting


Behavioral \& Professional Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under pressure.
* Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables.
* Ability to manage client and stakeholder expectations effectively.
* Pragmatic and solution\-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn and adopt emerging technologies and industry best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and dynamic technology environment.


What You Will Do in This Role


This role is suited for a **hands\-on DevOps Engineer**, not someone limited to pipeline administration.


You will be expected to work across the complete DevOps lifecycle — from infrastructure provisioning and automation to CI/CD, container orchestration, cloud deployments, GitOps, monitoring, security, troubleshooting, and production support.


You will also be expected to collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to improve **deployment efficiency, system reliability, scalability, security, and operational maturity**.

description:

**Title and Summary**


Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
About Mastercard  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

About The Role  

Cloud Infrastructure Engineers at Mastercard design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that enable our product and service teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale. This role focuses on Azure\-based infrastructure, cloud\-native services, and automation that power transaction processing, analytics, developer productivity, and self\-service delivery across the enterprise.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical ownership and influence that extends beyond a single team. You will drive the design and evolution of complex platform capabilities, set technical direction for key areas of cloud infrastructure, and partner closely with engineering, security, and operations leaders to ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business goals. While still hands\-on, your impact is measured by the systems, standards, and teams you enable.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Provide technical leadership for complex cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives spanning multiple teams or services
* Own the architecture, design, and implementation of critical Azure infrastructure components and platform capabilities
* Define and evolve standards, patterns, and guardrails for secure, scalable, and operable cloud solutions
* Lead cross\-team technical discussions, driving alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs
* Enable and improve self\-service provisioning and developer platforms that reduce friction and increase team autonomy
* Anticipate and mitigate systemic risks related to reliability, security, scalability, and cost
* Guide and mentor Senior and Software Engineer II team members through design reviews, feedback, and technical coaching
* Partner closely with product, security, operations, and architecture stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions

  

All About You  

  

* Overall 8\-12 years of career experience in a similar field
* Extensive hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating Azure\-based cloud infrastructure at scale, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and platform services
* Deep expertise with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation, using tools such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent, with a strong emphasis on modularity, reuse, and policy enforcement
* Strong command of cloud security and networking concepts, including identity and access management, private networking, secure service boundaries, and defense\-in\-depth architectures
* Proven experience designing resilient, highly available, and fault\-tolerant platforms, with a strong understanding of failure modes and disaster recovery strategies
* Demonstrated ability to lead large or complex initiatives end\-to\-end, including authoring and reviewing technical designs, decomposing work, sequencing delivery, and managing safe production rollouts
* Treats operability and cost efficiency as core design principles, ensuring observability, auditing, and financial transparency are built into platform solutions
* Advanced troubleshooting skills, capable of diagnosing and resolving broad, cross\-system production issues with minimal guidance
* Strong experience with enterprise CI/CD and SDLC practices, including quality gates, change management, and automation at scale
* Clear, influential communicator able to document architectures, establish technical direction, and drive consensus across distributed teams
* Consistent track record of mentoring and elevating other engineers, raising technical quality and ownership across the team
* Pragmatic and collaborative leader who balances technical excellence with delivery needs and organizational realities
* Actively evaluates industry trends in cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering and applies them thoughtfully to Mastercard’s ecosystem

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Platform / DevOps Engineer, Client Embedded Pod (Kubernetes / Observability / Data Infrastructure)
description:
**Experience:** 5\+ years, Mid\-Senior Level

**About** 

Langoor, A 'born in digital era' digital marketing agency is challenging/changing the very way marketers make sense of the digital disruption and navigate their way to Impact Business x Marketing x Brand Performance.

Going beyond the elementary impact of digital in terms of search, social and storytelling, marketers need to look at their customer journeys in the digital domains and focus their action based on insights of digital behaviour and contextise their marketing mix strategies and action.

Driving Indian Brands into the Digital First Marketing Era with our expertise in Data x Technology x Strategic Thinking x Creative Edge delivering agile Marketing Transformations \& Brand Performance.

**About the role**

You will join an embedded pod building the platform foundations that product and engineering teams run on, directly inside a client environment on live production systems. This is not a maintenance role. In a single quarter you could be hardening Kubernetes cluster lifecycle and capacity, tuning ClickHouse for high\-cardinality observability, and standing up or scaling Milvus for a retrieval or agent workload. The pod moves fast and the client expects production\-grade infrastructure, not one\-off scripts.

**What we expect from you**

* You write clean, production\-ready infrastructure and platform code, and you ship it fast. You do not need heavy process to move.
* You pick up unfamiliar stacks and tools quickly and without much hand holding – Kubernetes operators, GitOps, telemetry pipelines, columnar and vector databases.
* You already use modern AI tools to design, debug, and operate systems, and can show what that has done to your output.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and switch context across infrastructure domains – cluster work one week, data\-store tuning the next – without dropping reliability.
* You can hold a technical conversation directly with a client stakeholder, not just with your own team.
* You consistently turn platform work into measurable outcomes: developer velocity, cost control, and uptime.

**Must\-have skills**

* Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle management, Helm charts and operators, capacity planning, and multi\-tenant platform design
* GitOps workflows for infrastructure and application delivery (ArgoCD, Flux, or similar)
* ClickHouse or a comparable columnar store: schema design, ingestion pipelines, and query performance tuning for high\-cardinality observability data (logs, traces, metrics, wide events)
* Vector databases in production – Milvus or similar (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) – operating data planes for retrieval and agent workloads
* Telemetry pipeline design spanning logs, traces, and metrics
* Demonstrated use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, and awareness of how to apply AI capabilities to platform operations
* Git and version control workflows in a team setting (branching, PRs, code review)

**Good\-to\-have skills**

* Writing or extending Kubernetes operators and custom controllers
* Experience with complementary observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
* Cloud platform experience – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* CI/CD pipeline ownership, not just exposure
* Cost optimization or capacity forecasting for infrastructure spend
* Exposure to building AI agents or working with LLM APIs
* Comfortable writing infrastructure tests and validation as part of your normal workflow
* Experience working in fast, iterative cycles (agile or otherwise) with shifting priorities
* Prior experience working directly embedded with a client rather than purely internal teams

**What this role is not**

* This is not a role for someone who prefers a fixed scope and stable domain. The problem domain changes – cluster hardening one week, ClickHouse tuning the next, Milvus scaling after that.
* This is not an entry\-level supervised role. You will be expected to operate independently within a few weeks of starting.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**\# DevOps and Compliance Engineer – Roles \& Responsibilities**

**\#\# Role Overview**

A DevOps and Compliance Engineer (1–2 years experience) at Instape is responsible for bridging software development and IT operations by implementing automation, continuous integration and deployment, infrastructure management, and monitoring practices on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while helping uphold security, data\-protection, and regulatory\-compliance standards across the delivery lifecycle. Given Instape operates in the regulated digital\-lending / fintech space, the role also supports adherence to applicable financial\-services and data\-privacy requirements. It requires solid technical fundamentals, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate effectively across development, security, and business teams to ensure reliable, secure, and compliant software delivery.

**\#\# Key Responsibilities**

**\#\#\# Project \& Stakeholder Management**

\- Understand customer requirements, business objectives, and project KPIs.  
\- Collaborate with development, operations, security, and business teams to ensure seamless delivery.  
\- Maintain effective communication with internal teams and support stakeholder updates.  
\- Participate in sprint planning, task estimation, and team coordination activities.  
\- Provide periodic status updates and progress reports.

**\#\#\# Infrastructure \& Environment Management**

\- Set up, configure, and maintain development, testing, staging, and production environments on GCP.  
\- Design and manage scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure using Cloud Run (serverless containers), with Cloud Functions and Compute Engine where appropriate.  
\- Administer Linux\-based environments and virtual machines.  
\- Manage GCP networking, including Serverless VPC Access and Network Security configurations.

**\#\#\# DevOps \& Automation**

\- Define and implement DevOps processes, standards, and best practices.  
\- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, and Artifact Registry for automated integration, testing, container builds, and deployment.  
\- Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployments (Infrastructure as Code with Terraform).  
\- Continuously identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency.

**\#\#\# Software Development \& Release Management**

\- Review, validate, and verify application code and deployment configurations.  
\- Support development teams in troubleshooting application and deployment issues.  
\- Manage release planning, deployment scheduling, and rollback strategies (including Cloud Run revisions and traffic splitting).  
\- Ensure adherence to development, testing, release, and support processes.

**\#\#\# Monitoring \& Incident Management**

\- Monitor application performance, system health, and infrastructure utilization using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.  
\- Manage incident response, root cause analysis, and problem resolution.  
\- Implement proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms.  
\- Drive continuous improvement based on operational metrics and incident trends.

**\#\#\# Security \& Compliance**  
\- Implement and maintain security controls throughout the DevOps lifecycle using Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, and IAM.  
\- Support vulnerability assessment and image scanning via Container Analysis, and assist with risk management activities.  
\- Manage secure access using Identity\-Aware Proxy (IAP) and least\-privilege IAM policies.  
\- Support secure handling of sensitive and personally identifiable information (PII), including KYC and customer financial data, through encryption, access controls, and data\-retention practices.  
\- Maintain audit trails, access logs, consent records, and evidence to support internal and external audits, and assist in remediating findings from VAPT and audit exercises.  
\- Support incident reporting and breach\-notification processes in line with regulatory timelines (e.g., CERT\-In directives).  
\- Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, data\-localization requirements, and applicable industry and regulatory standards, and collaborate with security and compliance teams on secure development and deployment practices.

**\#\# Essential Skills \& Qualifications**

**\#\#\# Technical Skills**  
\- Working experience with Linux\-based infrastructure.  
\- Proficiency in scripting/programming such as Python (Bash and others a plus).  
\- Experience with databases such as Cloud Firestore, and relational databases like Cloud SQL / PostgreSQL / MySQL.  
\- Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities.

**\#\#\# DevOps Tools \& Technologies**  
\- Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Git, Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, Artifact Registry (experience with Jenkins/GitHub Actions is a plus).  
\- Experience with containerization using Docker.  
\- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.  
\- Exposure to event\-driven and workflow tooling — Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Workflows — is a plus.

**\#\#\# Cloud Technologies (GCP)**  
\- Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud\-based applications on Google Cloud Platform.  
\- Working knowledge of core GCP services: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Compute Engine, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Secret Manager, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging.

**\#\#\# Security \& Compliance**  
\- Understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, and risk assessment.  
\- Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and secure deployment methodologies.  
\- Awareness of data\-protection and privacy principles, and secure handling of sensitive customer data.

**\#\#\# Soft Skills**  
\- Good communication and collaboration skills.  
\- Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities.  
\- Ability to work in fast\-paced Agile and DevOps environments.

**\#\# Preferred Knowledge**  
\- Agile and Scrum methodologies.  
\- ITIL principles and incident management practices.  
\- Exposure to compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) is an added advantage.  
\- Awareness of data\-privacy regulations (India's DPDP Act; GDPR awareness a plus) and secure PII/KYC data handling.  
\- Familiarity with financial\-services / digital\-lending regulatory requirements (e.g., RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, KYC/AML norms, data\-localization requirements) is an added advantage.  
\- Understanding of CERT\-In incident\-reporting requirements.  
\- Firebase services (Authentication / Identity Toolkit, Remote Config, Cloud Messaging).  
\- Industry best practices for system reliability, scalability, and security.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and own the infrastructure and deployment pipelines that keep OMS running reliably for accredited labs across India and Australia. Downtime during a client's NABL assessment window isn't an option. You'll work with the engineering team to automate everything from CI/CD to monitoring, and ensure the platform scales as we grow into new markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for OMS backend and frontend services
* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP — provisioning, scaling, cost optimisation, and security hardening
* Implement and maintain container orchestration using Kubernetes or ECS
* Set up and own monitoring, alerting, and incident response — ensure the team knows about issues before clients do
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform or equivalent IaC tools
* Manage database reliability — backups, failover, replication, and performance tuning
* Work with engineering leads on release management, blue\-green deployments, and rollback procedures
* Ensure environment parity across development, staging, and production


**Requirements**
* 3–5 years of DevOps or platform engineering experience
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or GCP — EC2/ECS or GKE, RDS, S3, CloudWatch or equivalent
* Strong CI/CD pipeline experience — Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
* Proficiency with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
* Infrastructure\-as\-code experience — Terraform or AWS CDK preferred
* Experience with monitoring and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar
* Solid Linux administration and bash scripting skills
* Familiarity with database administration (MySQL / PostgreSQL) in production environments


 What you get
   

  

 Hybrid work — BengaluruCompetitive salary with performance incentivesOwn infrastructure for a live platform serving accredited labs across two countriesWork with a team that values reliability and automation over manual fixesLearning budget for certifications (AWS, GCP, CKA)

description:
**Who Are We**
 We Build Mission\-Ready, Cutting\-Edge Intelligent Autonomous Systems
   

  

 From battlefield supremacy to stratospheric dominance, NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is redefining aerospace and defence with intelligent autonomous systems built for the world’s most demanding missions. Trusted by the Indian Armed Forces across all services, NRT delivers breakthrough unmanned platforms that enable speed, survivability, multi\-domain mission flexibility, and strategic superiority.
   

  

 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT), founded in 2017, is a global leader in swarming technologies, autonomous robotics, and advanced aerospace systems for defense applications. With a workforce of over 600 professionals across 12 facilities worldwide—nearly 70% focused on research and development—NRT has designed and fielded more than 15 proprietary multirotor and fixed\-wing platforms. The company’s core expertise spans large\-scale UAV swarms, AI\-enabled autonomous coordination, and persistent unmanned systems, all validated through rigorous operational deployment in real\-world conflict environments.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 Design, implement, and maintain Docker\-based development, build, packaging, and deployment workflows across multiple software projects
   

  

 Set up, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for build, test, release, and deployment automation
   

  

 Define and enforce best practices for containerization, build reproducibility, release processes, and deployment consistency
   

  

 Develop and improve automation for build systems, environment provisioning, deployment workflows, and release validation
   

  

 Manage and optimize Docker images, including multi\-stage and multi\-architecture builds, dependency management, image size optimization, portability across target platforms, and runtime efficiency
   

  

 Collaborate with development teams to standardize containerized local development and deployment environments
   

  

 Participate in peer reviews of solution designs, infrastructure changes, CI/CD workflows, Dockerfiles, and source code
   

  

 Contribute to defining and enforcing engineering standards, branching strategies, code quality checks, and release practices
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to container builds, CI/CD failures, deployment bottlenecks, environment drift, and runtime stability
   

  

 Perform performance analysis and support troubleshooting in large\-scale distributed systems
   

  

 Improve system stability, security, efficiency, scalability, and operational reliability
   

  

 Collaborate across teams to identify delivery risks early and reduce deployment and integration issues
   

  

**Skills Required**
 Minimum 3\+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, release engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation
   

  

 Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with Docker and container\-based software delivery workflows
   

  

 Good understanding of Docker image creation, multi\-stage builds, container lifecycle management, networking, volumes, and debugging containerized applications
   

  

 Experience building and maintaining multi\-architecture Docker images for different target platforms and deployment environments
   

  

 Proficiency with Git and experience with repository management, branching models, merge strategies, and code quality checks
   

  

 Experience automating build, release, and deployment pipelines for multiple projects
   

  

 Strong debugging skills and experience fixing stability and deployment issues without introducing regressions
   

  

 Solid understanding of release engineering, software delivery practices, and environment management
   

  

 Experience working with distributed systems and complex software architectures
   

  

 Ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
   

  

 Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and drive technical improvements across projects
   

  

**Good To Have**
 Experience with Docker Compose and/or container orchestration environments
   

  

 Experience with Shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for automation
   

  

 Experience designing and implementing Continuous Delivery / DevOps architecture patterns
   

  

 Familiarity with Linux\-based systems and shell environments
   

  

 Familiarity with ROS\-based systems
   

  

 Experience deploying and maintaining software on edge devices such as Jetson Xavier
   

  

**Required Skills**
* DevOps
* Virtualization and Cloud Computing \- Docker
* Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD)
* container orchestration
* container builds
* Dockerfiles

**About The Role**
 A Cloud Engineering Specialist (Platform) is responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving shared engineering platforms, DevOps tools, and services across both cloud and on premises environments. The role enables engineering teams to deliver software that is secure, reliable, scalable, performant, and cost efficient, regardless of where workloads are hosted.
   

  

 Guided by Well Architected Framework principles, the specialist ensures that engineering best practices are embedded by default into platform infrastructure—including on prem, hybrid, and cloud foundations—as well as into enabling pipelines and operational tooling. This allows development and testing teams to focus on business outcomes and product delivery, rather than infrastructure complexity, tooling overhead, or ongoing platform and service maintenance.
   

  

 This supports BT’s strategic priorities by designing solutions that are customer focused, outcome led, and aligned to business objectives (Customer First).
   

  

 The role brings clarity and structure to complex delivery challenges (Clear), challenges existing approaches to drive simplification and improvement (Challenger), and works collaboratively across teams to enable successful implementation (Connected).
   

  

 Through accountable ownership of platform stability \& outcomes, the role demonstrates strong commitment to delivering reliable, high quality solutions that enable transformation (Committed).
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Platform Solution Delivery \- You will design and deliver secure, reliable, and repeatable platform solutions that meet business and engineering needs.
   

  

* Platform, DevOps \& Testing Enablement \- You will build, operate, and continuously improve shared platforms, DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, and testing services across cloud and on prem environments.
* Secure \& Resilient by Design \- You will embed security, resilience, compliance, and reliability by default, aligned with BT security and risk frameworks.
* Well Architected Engineering \- You will apply Well Architected Framework principles across platform infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.
* Cross Team Collaboration \- You will collaborate with engineering, testing, security, operations, and architecture teams to shape practical and scalable solutions.
* Specialist Technical Expertise \- You will provide specialist expertise in one or more domains such as platform engineering, security, quality engineering, observability, or resilience.
* Enterprise Architecture Alignment \- You will ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, guardrails, and approved technology patterns.
* Recommendations \& Solution Design \- You will create clear recommendations, solution designs, and scope documents, identifying dependencies, risks, and gaps early.
* Platform Operations \& Reliability \- You will operate platforms with a strong focus on availability, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring \- You will share knowledge through standards, documentation, and mentoring, helping teams adopt consistent engineering practices.
* Technology Advisory \& Innovation \- You will advise on relevant technologies and emerging trends to inform platform, DevOps, and tooling strategy.
* Architecture Governance \- You will support architecture governance and design forums as a trusted technical contributor and reviewer.


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Designing practical solutions \- You can turn business and engineering needs into clear, workable technical designs that teams can build, run, and support with confidence.
* Understanding user and business needs \- You listen carefully to stakeholders and teams, and clearly capture what is needed from platforms, tools, or services.
* Making informed decisions \- You can compare options, explain trade offs, and make clear, evidence based decisions that balance risk, cost, and value.
* Working with modern platforms \- You have hands on experience designing, building, or operating cloud based and/or on prem platforms, including infrastructure, DevOps tools, or shared services.
* Delivering solutions into live environments\- You can support the safe rollout of new platforms, tools, or capabilities, considering reliability, security, and impact to users.
* Operating and improving systems \- You monitor system health, performance, and reliability, and act when things do not work as expected.
* Collaborating with others \- You work well with people from different teams and backgrounds, value diverse views, and contribute to an inclusive, respectful working environment.
* Learning and adapting \- You show curiosity, learn from feedback, and are open to building new skills as technology and ways of working change.
* Platform engineering experience – You will have experience in building or maintaining shared platforms, DevOps tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or testing services across cloud or on prem environments.
* Security and reliability awareness – You will understand how to design systems that are secure, resilient, and compliant by default
* Well Architected understanding\- You will be familiar with Well Architected Framework principles and how they influence platform and solution design
* Infrastructure automation – You will have experience using automation or infrastructure as code to improve consistency and reduce manual effort
* Documentation and knowledge sharing – Your ability to create clear documentation, standards, or guidance that helps others work more effectively
* Coaching or mentoring – Your experience in supporting or guiding other engineers through technical discussions or shared problem solving


**Desirable Skills / Experience**
* Designing systems that integrate well \- Creating solutions that work smoothly with other systems, including through APIs or shared services.
* Working within regulatory or compliance environments \- Understanding how to design and deliver solutions that meet legal, regulatory, or industry standards.
* Shaping product direction \- Helping to define a longer term vision or roadmap and aligning teams around shared goals.
* Enterprise level architecture \- Designing solutions that fit within a wider organisational technology landscape.
* Supporting bids or proposals \- Contributing technical input to business cases, tenders, or funding proposals.
* Observability and operations \- Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or incident response practices that improve platform reliability


 BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
   

  

 BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
   

  

 Having come through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
   

  

 We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer\-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

* Strong platform ownership and reliability mindset.
* Strong understanding of both cloud platform engineering and observability.

* Ability to think across the entire cloud and application ecosystem.

title: Senior Build Engineer
description:
**Summary:** 




 Join the MathWorks Infrastructure Architecture and Tools team and play a key role in building the next generation of scalable, reliable, and high\-performance build systems that power the MathWorks product suite.
 



 As a Senior Build Engineer, you will lead initiatives to modernize our build infrastructure, enable distributed and scalable build workflows, and drive improvements in developer productivity. You will partner closely with development teams to deliver robust, maintainable solutions across platforms while advancing adoption of modern build technologies and practices.
 



**Why Join Us?** 



* Work on large\-scale, complex build systems supporting a globally used product suite
* Influence next\-generation build and infrastructure architecture
* Collaborate with highly skilled engineers across platforms and domains
* Drive impactful improvements in developer productivity and product quality



 MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Drive Build Infrastructure Modernization:** 



* Evaluate modern build systems and lead the design, and implementation of scalable, future\-ready solutions
* Transition legacy workflows to modern, distributed build ecosystem



  





**2\. Build Automation \& Developer Productivity:** 



* Design and develop automation tools to streamline build and development workflows
* Improve reliability, reproducibility, and efficiency across a large and diverse codebase
* Analyze and improve build performance, resource utilization, and system scalability
* Build observability metrics to measure the improvements



  





**3\. Toolchain \& Compiler Enablement:** 



* Lead efforts to port and refactor code for compatibility with modern compilers and evolving C\+\+ standards
* Enable adoption of new toolchains across multiple platforms
* Expand and maintain support for Linux, Windows, and macOS environments



  





**4\. Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** 



* Act as a subject matter expert for build systems and infrastructure
* Partner with engineering teams to diagnose and resolve complex build and toolchain issues
* Establish and promote best practices for build engineering across the organization



  





**5\. Code Quality \& Reviews** 



* Conduct in\-depth code and infrastructure reviews, ensuring maintainability and adherence to best practices



  





**6\. Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
* Document systems, processes, and best practices for long\-term sustainability



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required.
* Programming experience in C\+\+



  





**Additional Qualifications** 



* Strong experience working with large\-scale, multi\-language codebases
* Expertise in modern distributed build systems (e.g., Bazel, CMake, Make, or similar) and remote execution frameworks on different platforms
* Proficiency in C\+\+ and one or more programming/scripting languages (Go, Python, Bash, etc.)
* Solid understanding of compiler toolchains and experience with compiler\-related workflows
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across build systems, compiler toolchains, and cross\-platform environments



**Must Have:** 



* Strong System Design Skills
* Knowledge of CI/CD systems and large\-scale build pipelines
* Experience applying AI\-assisted tools, with the ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs



**Nice to Have:** 



* Familiarity and knowledge of package managers of C\+\+ like Conan



  





 MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in\-person time with colleagues and flexible at\-home life optimizations.
 



 Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying\-and\-interviewing.html\#onboarding.

description:

 15\+ years overall IT experience (8\+ years in Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineering leadership)

 Bangalore \- Hybrid
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking a
 **Director – Cloud \& DevOps Engineering** 
 to lead enterprise\-scale cloud engineering, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering initiatives across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for someone who can architect solutions, drive automation\-first engineering, own end\-to\-end delivery, and operate as a trusted advisor to senior client and internal stakeholders.
 



 The ideal candidate combines deep technical depth (cloud architecture, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, observability, security) with proven experience leading large engineering teams and managing complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs.

**Cloud Architecture \& Engineering** 



* Architect scalable, secure, highly available, cost\-optimized platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP

 AWS / Azure / GCP • Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) • Docker • Terraform • Ansible • Helm • Jenkins • GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps • ArgoCD/GitOps • Python/Java • Linux \& Shell scripting • REST APIs • Prometheus/Grafana • ELK/Splunk/Dynatrace • Cloud networking \& security • DR/HA • Cost optimization

* Strong hands\-on technical credibility combined with senior delivery/people leadership
* Track record leading large\-scale, multi\-cloud transformation programs
* Excellent executive communication and customer relationship management skills
* Comfortable balancing deep technical involvement with P\&L/delivery accountability

title: Storage Specialist
description:
Job Summary
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Storage Engineer / Storage SME** 
 responsible for the administration, engineering, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and lifecycle management of enterprise storage infrastructure.
 



 The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with
 **NetApp, HPE Alletra, HSX Storage, Dell EMC Data Domain, and AWS FSx** 
 , along with good knowledge of SAN/NAS technologies, storage replication, backup, disaster recovery, and cloud storage.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Administer and support enterprise storage platforms including:
* **NetApp ONTAP**
* **HPE Alletra**
* **HSX Storage**
* **Dell EMC Data Domain**
* **AWS FSx / FSx for NetApp ONTAP**
* Perform storage provisioning, volume/LUN creation, host mapping, capacity management, and storage expansion.
* Manage
 **NAS and SAN environments** 
 using NFS, SMB/CIFS, iSCSI, and Fibre Channel.
* Configure and manage NetApp:
* SVMs
* Aggregates/storage pools
* Volumes and LUNs
* Snapshots
* SnapMirror
* FlexVol/FlexClone
* Replication and DR
* Manage HPE Alletra storage including volumes, hosts, protection policies, snapshots, replication, and performance monitoring.
* Administer
 **Dell EMC Data Domain** 
 for backup storage, deduplication, replication, capacity management, and troubleshooting.
* Manage
 **AWS FSx** 
 , particularly FSx for NetApp ONTAP, including SVMs, volumes, NFS/SMB shares, snapshots, replication, and performance/capacity management. AAWS Documentation
* Support hybrid connectivity and data movement between on\-premises storage and AWS.
* Perform storage migrations, technology refreshes, firmware upgrades, and controller/storage expansions.
* Monitor storage capacity, latency, IOPS, throughput, utilization, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot storage performance, connectivity, multipathing, replication, and availability issues.
* Participate in
 **L2/L3 incident, problem, and change management** 
 .
* Develop and maintain storage backup, retention, high\-availability, and disaster\-recovery solutions.
* Perform DR testing and validate replication/recovery procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors such as NetApp, HPE, Dell EMC, and AWS for critical incidents and escalations.
* Create operational documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Automate routine storage administration using
 **PowerShell, Python, Bash, or storage CLI/API** 
 where applicable.
* Work closely with server, Linux/Windows, VMware, database, network, backup, security, and cloud teams.



  





 Required Technical Skills
 



  





**NetApp** 



* ONTAP / Clustered Data ONTAP
* FAS/AFF
* SVM, LIF, aggregate, volume and LUN management
* NFS, SMB/CIFS, iSCSI, FC
* Snapshot, SnapMirror, SnapVault
* FlexVol, FlexClone
* Performance and capacity management



**HPE Alletra** 



* Alletra administration
* Volume and host management
* Snapshots and replication
* Performance monitoring
* SAN/NAS concepts
* DR and high availability



**HSX Storage** 



* Storage provisioning and administration
* Capacity and performance monitoring
* SAN/NAS troubleshooting
* Replication and data protection
* Storage lifecycle management



**Dell EMC Data Domain** 



* Data Domain administration
* Deduplication
* Replication
* Backup integration
* Capacity monitoring
* Data Domain troubleshooting and performance management



**AWS FSx** 



* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
* SVM and volume management
* NFS/SMB
* Snapshots and replication
* AWS networking fundamentals
* Data migration using AWS DataSync
* AWS Backup / S3 integration where applicable



 AWS DataSync can transfer data to and from FSx for ONTAP using NFS or SMB, making DataSync knowledge particularly useful for hybrid\-storage and migration responsibilities.

title: Java Production Support
description:
Job Description: Java Spring Boot Kafka Production Support Engineer (6\-10 Years Experience)
   

  

**Position:** 
 Java Spring Boot Kafka Production Support Engineer
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\-10 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

 Please fill the Candidate details using the below Link.
   

  

 Cognizant Interview \-Candidate Registration Details – Fill out form
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Java Spring Boot Kafka Production Support Engineer** 
 with 6\-10 years of IT experience to support and maintain mission\-critical applications in a production environment. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, troubleshooting production issues, incident management, monitoring, and performance optimization while ensuring high application availability and stability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for Java\-based enterprise applications.
* Monitor application health, identify issues proactively, and ensure maximum uptime.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents within defined SLAs.
* Analyze application logs and perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents.
* Support and maintain microservices built using Spring Boot.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Kafka topics, consumer groups, brokers, and message flows.
* Manage deployment activities and production releases.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve complex issues.
* Perform application performance tuning and optimization.
* Participate in on\-call support and rotational shifts as required.
* Create and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents.


**Required Technical Skills**
 Core Java \& Frameworks
   

  

* Strong experience in Java 8/11/17\.
* Expertise in Spring Boot and Spring Framework.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and Microservices Architecture.
* Good understanding of multithreading, collections, exception handling, and JVM concepts.


 Kafka
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Apache Kafka.
* Knowledge of Kafka Producers, Consumers, Topics, Partitions, and Consumer Groups.
* Experience in troubleshooting message failures, lag monitoring, and offset management.
* Understanding of Kafka performance tuning and monitoring.


 Database
   

  

* Experience with SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
* Ability to write complex SQL queries for troubleshooting and data analysis.
* Understanding of database performance tuning concepts.


 Production Support
   

  

* Experience in Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Remedy.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Exposure to SLA, RCA, and ITIL\-based support processes.


 Monitoring \& DevOps
   

  

* Experience with Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Prometheus.
* Knowledge of Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Git, Maven, and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Experience in application deployment and release management.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  






  




**What You Will Be Doing:** 
  

  
* Own and lead quality efforts for significant product areas or cross\-team initiatives, defining and driving execution of comprehensive test strategies (functional, integration, performance, and system testing).
  
* Support developers in large initiatives to "shift quality left"—ensuring they can run acceptance tests locally and sharing techniques to improve how developers test and validate their own changes.
  
* Develop, execute, and maintain complex automated test scripts (using Python, Pytest, TypeScript, etc.) alongside the development team to enforce collective ownership of quality.
  
* Participate actively in Post\-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and drive toward comprehensive solutions to prevent repeat incidents.
  
* Plan and complete the Readiness Review testing sections for tasked initiatives, managing end\-to\-end acceptance and exploratory testing at the epic level.
  
* Conduct complex debugging, including staging/production issue reproduction and root cause analysis, helping to troubleshoot issues even outside of your immediate team.
  
* Partner with the Pillar Lead and Protectobot to identify and address technical gaps in test coverage, unblock framework issues, and implement AI\-assisted testing efficiencies.
  
* Mentor and coach QE 1s, QE 2s, and QE 3s, guiding them on advanced testing techniques, and act as a technical interviewer during hiring processes.
  
* Evaluate risk vs. schedule, balancing comprehensive testing with rapid delivery timelines to optimize engineering velocity.
  
* Collaborate with architects and development leads to ensure overall system testability and robustness.
  

  


  


  




**You have:** 
  

  
* 6\-8 years of experience in test planning, automation framework utilization, and Agile collaboration, with a reputation for tackling hard problems.
  
* Advanced proficiency in automation tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, Pytest, Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript).
  
* Deep experience with diverse testing methodologies, including performance, security, integration, and exploratory testing.
  
* Proven ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable test automation solutions.
  
* In\-depth knowledge of CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and troubleshooting tools to support efficient release cycles.
  
* Strong ability to identify when and how to escalate issues to ensure swift resolution.
  
* Experience enabling development teams to manage their own testing and fostering a culture of collective quality ownership.
  
* A collaborative, team\-oriented mindset, displaying ownership of quality for epics and proactively identifying problems early.
  
* Strong communication skills, thinking globally about customer needs and collaborating effectively across teams and hemispheres.
  
* Proven ability to define and execute strategies for augmenting test coverage, strategically layering Unit Tests, Functional Tests, and Acceptance Tests across the full test automation pyramid.
  

  


  


  




**Bonus Points If You Have:** 
  

  
* Practical experience leveraging Generative AI or LLMs in the software testing lifecycle to improve test efficiency.
  
* Deep domain expertise in areas relevant to our pillars (e.g., Identity/Directory protocols, Authentication flows, MDM/Device Management, or Cloud Platforms).
  
* Experience with API and web app UI test automation tools like Gherkin, Cypress, or similar.
  
* Deep expertise in designing and implementing Go\-based Unit Tests (UT) and leveraging functional testing (FT) frameworks to ensure robust component and service reliability.
  
* Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud\-based servers (AWS experience is a plus).
  
* Prior experience in dynamic, fast\-paced startup environments.
  

  


  





  




  


**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Lead/Senior SRE Engineer - Dynatrace
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for an experienced **Lead/Senior SRE Engineer with strong Dynatrace expertise** to join our team.


In this role, you will drive the implementation of DevOps and SRE practices, shape the technology roadmap, and ensure the reliability, performance, and observability of our production systems. You will collaborate closely with application teams and product owners to foster a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Promote and create automated processes wherever possible
* Implement cybersecurity measures through ongoing vulnerability assessment and risk management
* Prepare periodic progress reporting for management and the customer
* Collaborate with application teams to simplify adoption of the platform, and coordinate communication within the team and with customers
* Review the current system and produce plans for enhancements and improvements

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of general IT experience, including 5\+ years within DevOps or SRE teams
* Solid background in supporting production infrastructure
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD
* Deep understanding of observability (monitoring, logging, and tracing)
* Proven expertise in Dynatrace and Splunk
* Familiarity with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong ability to operate high\-availability, fault\-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively, with strong organization, interpersonal skills, and experience building operational maturity
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, including strategic thinking and the ability to troubleshoot under pressure
* Adaptability to pick up new technologies quickly
* English proficiency at B2 (Upper\-Intermediate) or higher

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Overview: Looking for an experienced candidate with a blend of DevOps/Platform Engineering with automation and AI capabilities. This role will lead automation, platform modernization, cloud\-native adoption, observability, and security initiatives while enabling developers through self\-service platform capabilities. The ideal candidate should have expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, IAC, CI/CD, Platform Automation, Observability tools, Networking, Security and emerging AIOps technologies.  

This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. Position Details:
**About the Role:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and operation of secure, scalable, highly available cloud\-native platforms across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code principles.
* Drive Platform Engineering initiatives by building Internal Developer Platforms (IDP), self\-service capabilities, modern CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity solutions.
* Implement Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices including observability, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, APM, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, incident management, and production reliability.
* Develop automation frameworks, self\-healing systems, AI\-assisted operational workflows, and intelligent remediation capabilities to improve efficiency and reduce MTTR.
* Partner closely with Product, Security, Platform, and Architecture teams to lead cloud modernization, application migrations, Kubernetes adoption, DevSecOps integration, governance, compliance automation, and policy\-as\-code initiatives.
* Optimize cloud costs through FinOps practices while supporting mission\-critical production environments and continuously evaluating emerging technologies, AI\-driven engineering solutions, and modern platform capabilities.

**About You:**

description:
**DevOps and Compliance Engineer – Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 A DevOps and Compliance Engineer (1–2 years experience) at Instape is responsible for bridging software development and IT operations by implementing automation, continuous integration and deployment, infrastructure management, and monitoring practices on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while helping uphold security, data\-protection, and regulatory\-compliance standards across the delivery lifecycle. Given Instape operates in the regulated digital\-lending / fintech space, the role also supports adherence to applicable financial\-services and data\-privacy requirements. It requires solid technical fundamentals, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate effectively across development, security, and business teams to ensure reliable, secure, and compliant software delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Project \& Stakeholder Management
 



 \- Understand customer requirements, business objectives, and project KPIs.
 



 \- Collaborate with development, operations, security, and business teams to ensure seamless delivery.
 



 \- Maintain effective communication with internal teams and support stakeholder updates.
 



 \- Participate in sprint planning, task estimation, and team coordination activities.
 



 \- Provide periodic status updates and progress reports.
 



  





 Infrastructure \& Environment Management
 



 \- Set up, configure, and maintain development, testing, staging, and production environments on GCP.
 



 \- Design and manage scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure using Cloud Run (serverless containers), with Cloud Functions and Compute Engine where appropriate.
 



 \- Administer Linux\-based environments and virtual machines.
 



 \- Manage GCP networking, including Serverless VPC Access and Network Security configurations.
 



  





 DevOps \& Automation
 



 \- Define and implement DevOps processes, standards, and best practices.
 



 \- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, and Artifact Registry for automated integration, testing, container builds, and deployment.
 



 \- Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployments (Infrastructure as Code with Terraform).
 



 \- Continuously identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency.
 



  





 Software Development \& Release Management
 



 \- Review, validate, and verify application code and deployment configurations.
 



 \- Support development teams in troubleshooting application and deployment issues.
 



 \- Manage release planning, deployment scheduling, and rollback strategies (including Cloud Run revisions and traffic splitting).
 



 \- Ensure adherence to development, testing, release, and support processes.
 



  





 Monitoring \& Incident Management
 



 \- Monitor application performance, system health, and infrastructure utilization using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
 



 \- Manage incident response, root cause analysis, and problem resolution.
 



 \- Implement proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms.
 



 \- Drive continuous improvement based on operational metrics and incident trends.
 



  





 Security \& Compliance
 


* Implement and maintain security controls throughout the DevOps lifecycle using Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, and IAM.
* Support vulnerability assessment and image scanning via Container Analysis, and assist with risk management activities.
* Manage secure access using Identity\-Aware Proxy (IAP) and least\-privilege IAM policies.
* Support secure handling of sensitive and personally identifiable information (PII), including KYC and customer financial data, through encryption, access controls, and data\-retention practices.
* Maintain audit trails, access logs, consent records, and evidence to support internal and external audits, and assist in remediating findings from VAPT and audit exercises.
* Support incident reporting and breach\-notification processes in line with regulatory timelines (e.g., CERT\-In directives).
* Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, data\-localization requirements, and applicable industry and regulatory standards, and collaborate with security and compliance teams on secure development and deployment practices.



  





**Essential Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Technical Skills:** 




 \- Working experience with Linux\-based infrastructure.
 



 \- Proficiency in scripting/programming such as Python (Bash and others a plus).
 



 \- Experience with databases such as Cloud Firestore, and relational databases like Cloud SQL / PostgreSQL / MySQL.
 



 \- Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities.
 



  





**DevOps Tools \& Technologies** 




 \- Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Git, Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, Artifact Registry (experience with Jenkins/GitHub Actions is a plus).
 



 \- Experience with containerization using Docker.
 



 \- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
 



 \- Exposure to event\-driven and workflow tooling — Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Workflows is a plus.
 



  





**Cloud Technologies (GCP)** 




 \- Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud\-based applications on Google Cloud Platform.
 



 \- Working knowledge of core GCP services: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Compute Engine, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Secret Manager, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging.
 



  





**Security \& Compliance:** 




 \- Understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, and risk assessment.
 



 \- Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and secure deployment methodologies.
 



 \- Awareness of data\-protection and privacy principles, and secure handling of sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Soft Skills:** 




 \- Good communication and collaboration skills.
 



 \- Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



 \- Ability to work in fast\-paced Agile and DevOps environments.
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge:** 




 \- Agile and Scrum methodologies.
 



 \- ITIL principles and incident management practices.
 



 \- Exposure to compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) is an added advantage.
 



 \- Awareness of data\-privacy regulations (India's DPDP Act; GDPR awareness a plus) and secure PII/KYC data handling.
 



 \- Familiarity with financial\-services / digital\-lending regulatory requirements (e.g., RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, KYC/AML norms, data\-localization requirements) is an added advantage.
 



 \- Understanding of CERT\-In incident\-reporting requirements.
 



 \- Firebase services (Authentication / Identity Toolkit, Remote Config, Cloud Messaging).

 Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.
   

  

 WW RR\&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR\&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing groundbreaking products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon \- returns and recommerce.
   

  

 Amazon WW RR\&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

 The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance.  Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles.
