title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer (AWS / Kubernetes / Terraform / CI/CD)
description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Work From Office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
 



**Posted on behalf of our client.** 




  





**Design the leanest, most resilient cloud that scales from ten restaurants to ten thousand without a re\-write — and keep the 2 AM page from ever coming.** 




 Our client — a fast\-growing restaurant\-analytics and consulting startup in Kolkata, founded by leaders from top e\-commerce companies and premier institutes — is hiring a battle\-tested DevOps \& Cloud Engineer: part infrastructure architect, part reliability engineer, part cost optimiser. This is a blank\-slate role for someone who has run real production across more than one cloud and can be trusted to design it right.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 You will own the platform's infrastructure and delivery lifecycle end\-to\-end: architect and provision the AWS footprint (EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, ECR, Route 53\), containerise and orchestrate services with Docker and Kubernetes, and run the data\-and\-messaging backbone (PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka). You'll build the CI/CD pipelines that ship a Node / React / Python stack safely, tame the runtime and web tier (NVM, Pyenv, nginx / Apache, Caddy / Traefik, Certbot), and keep every environment — Dev, QA, Staging, Production — fast, observable, and cheap to run. Above all, you'll bring seasoned, opinionated judgement from multiple cloud ecosystems to recommend the most cost\-effective, seamlessly\-scalable path for every decision.
 



  





**The AI\-Augmented Edge** 
 Here, AI is your primary workforce. You'll use Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini to draft IaC, generate pipeline configs, review infra diffs, and reason about failure modes — targeting a 3x\-5x efficiency gain. You'll practise Cross\-LLM Validation: one model proposes the architecture, another stress\-tests it for cost, blast\-radius, and scaling limits. Your value is measured by uptime, unit economics, and how gracefully the platform scales — not tickets closed.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Cloud Architecture \& IaC:** 
 Design, provision, and harden EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), S3, ECR, and Route 53 as reproducible infrastructure. Own the estate in Terraform / CloudFormation (or Pulumi / CDK) with modular, reviewed, version\-controlled definitions and least\-privilege IAM.
* **Cloud\-Agnostic, Cost\-Effective Judgement:** 
 Bring real experience from more than one provider (AWS plus GCP / Azure / DigitalOcean) to pick the right primitive and avoid lock\-in; right\-size compute, exploit spot / reserved / savings plans, and treat the cloud invoice as a product metric.
* **Containers \& Orchestration:** 
 Containerise every service and run it on Kubernetes (EKS or self\-managed) with sane resource limits, autoscaling, health checks, and zero\-downtime rollouts.
* **Data \& Messaging Backbone:** 
 Operate PostgreSQL (replication, backups, PITR, tuning), Redis (cache / queues), and Kafka (event streaming) as first\-class, monitored, recoverable services. Manage Node (NVM) and Python (Pyenv) runtimes; front the platform with nginx / Apache and Caddy / Traefik with automated TLS via Certbot / ACME.
* **CI/CD \& Automation:** 
 Co\-own GitHub Actions (build, test, scan, deploy) with reproducible builds, artifact versioning in ECR, and blue\-green / canary rollouts. Standardise git\-based, push\-button deploys with fast, auditable rollbacks; manage secrets and config safely (SSM / Secrets Manager / Vault) with no credentials in git.
* **Reliability \& SRE:** 
 Stand up metrics, logs, and traces (CloudWatch, Prometheus / Grafana, ELK, PagerDuty) with actionable alarms; define and defend SLOs, RTO / RPO targets, backups, and rehearsed DR / failover; be first responder for incidents and run blameless post\-mortems.
* **Advisory \& Leadership:** 
 Bring cost / scaling / reliability trade\-off proposals to the CTO; maintain infrastructure runbooks, deployment standards, and on\-call playbooks; mentor engineers on deployment, containers, and operational best practice; partner with the Security Lead on hardening, IAM, network segmentation, and audit\-friendly logging.



  





**Must\-Have** 



* 6\-10 years running production infrastructure for a SaaS / cloud\-native product end\-to\-end.
* AWS depth: hands\-on EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, ECR, Route 53, IAM, and VPC networking in real production.
* Genuine multi\-cloud exposure (AWS plus GCP / Azure / DO) — able to compare and choose, not just operate one.
* Strong Docker and Kubernetes (EKS or self\-managed): autoscaling, rollouts, resource management.
* IaC \& CI/CD: Terraform / CloudFormation and pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions or equivalent) with rollback\-safe deploys.
* Data \& runtime ops: PostgreSQL (backup / replication / tuning), Redis, and the web / runtime tier (nginx / Apache, Caddy / Traefik, Certbot, NVM, Pyenv).
* A track record of cutting cloud spend and scaling systems smoothly — with the numbers to prove it.



  





**Should\-Have** 



* Kafka (or equivalent) for high\-throughput, ordered event pipelines.
* Observability \& SRE: CloudWatch / Prometheus / Grafana / ELK / PagerDuty, SLOs, RTO / RPO, rehearsed DR / failover.
* Solid networking \& TLS: DNS, load balancing, reverse proxies, certificate automation.
* Scripting in Bash plus Python / Node to automate anything that repeats.
* Comfortable in Agile / Scrum and working closely with engineering, product, and leadership.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Degree from a premier institute (IITs / NITs / BITS / IIITs) and/or AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / CKA / CKAD certification.
* Security\-adjacent ops: IAM hardening, secrets management, compliance\-friendly logging.
* AI\-augmented tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini) for IaC drafting, config review, and incident reasoning.
* Prior ownership of infrastructure through rapid growth on a lean budget.

Experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and DevSecOps principles is required; OpenShift is a plus.


**Experience 10\-12 Years**
**Education B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science**

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Overview: The Senior DevOps Engineer is responsible for building and operating production\-scale platform engineering capabilities on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS/GKE), with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.  

This is a highly hands\-on role focused on implementing and enhancing cloud\-native platforms, CI/CD systems, developer platforms (Backstage), and secure software delivery practices. The role works closely with platform, SRE, and engineering teams to improve system reliability and engineering efficiency.  

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in cloud\-native technologies, enterprise CI/CD, and large\-scale production environments.  

This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India, development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. Position Details:
**About You:**

* You will design, implement, and manage large\-scale Kubernetes platforms (EKS/GKE), including multi\-region deployments that ensure high availability, scalability, and business continuity.
* You will oversee the complete Kubernetes cluster lifecycle, including provisioning, upgrades, patching, scaling, and disaster recovery planning.
* You will build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Harness to improve deployment speed, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* You will develop and operate EKS environments leveraging technologies such as Cilium, Istio/Envoy, Karpenter, IRSA, and Pod Identity, while contributing to the adoption of Backstage through templates, scaffolding workflows, and service catalog management.
* You will create reusable Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) modules, platform automation frameworks, and AI\-driven capabilities such as deployment risk analysis, anomaly detection, and pipeline insights.
* You will strengthen platform security, observability, and reliability by implementing DevSecOps best practices, defining SLIs/SLOs, participating in incident response, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to enhance developer experience and platform adoption.

**About the role:**

* You should have 5 to 8years of experience in DevOps and Platform Engineering, with strong hands\-on expertise managing production\-scale Kubernetes environments on EKS and GKE.
* You should have deep proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Harness, with a focus on automation, scalability, and operational reliability.
* You should possess strong programming skill in Python, along with a solid understanding of Kubernetes networking, RBAC, autoscaling, service meshes, API gateways, and multi\-cloud environments across AWS.
* You should have experience with Backstage developer platforms and a proven ability to build reusable developer workflows, golden paths, and self\-service capabilities that enhance engineering productivity.
* You should demonstrate knowledge of DevSecOps practices, software supply chain security, artifact governance tools, Kafka, and AI\-powered DevOps solutions that drive operational efficiency and deployment intelligence.
* You should have excellent communication, collaboration, and technical documentation skills; certifications such as AWS or GCP Solutions Architect, CKA, CKAD, CKS, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate will be considered an added advantage.

 Chennai \| Full\-time \| 3–5 years\-experience

 10LPA
 



  
 



**About the role** 




 NeuraNX.AI builds and operates AI and speech\-processing platforms for global enterprise customers. We are looking for an Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps team in Chennai.
 



 You will help run GPU\-backed workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service, keep our deployment pipelines healthy, automate away manual operations work, and take a real part in production releases and reliability. It is a small team, so the work is hands\-on and your decisions are visible.
 



  
 



**What you will do** 




 • Operate and maintain AKS clusters across development, QA and production environments — node pools, autoscaling, RBAC and upgrades.
 



 • Deploy applications through GitOps workflows and support release windows from pre\-checks to post\-deployment validation.
 



 • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines: container image builds, registry pushes, environment configuration and secret rotation.
 



 • Automate routine operations with Bash, Python or PowerShell — scheduled scaling, cleanup jobs, environment provisioning.
 



 • Manage Azure infrastructure: virtual machines, networking, storage, managed databases and ingress.
 



 • Track cloud spend and drive optimisation — rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, reservation analysis and automated shutdown of non\-production environments.
 



 • Maintain backup, archival and disaster\-recovery processes, including restore testing.
 



 • Set up and tune monitoring and alerting, and write the runbooks that let the next person fix it at 3 a.m.
 



  
 



**What we are looking for** 




 • 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure or SRE.
 



 • Strong production experience with Azure (preferred) and AWS (basic).
 



 • Real operational experience with managed Kubernetes — AKS, EKS or GKE.
 



 • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
 



 • Solid Docker and Linux administration skills.
 



 • Scripting ability in Bash and Python or PowerShell.
 



 • Comfortable with Git\-based workflows and code review.
 



 • Clear written and spoken English — you will work directly with international stakeholders.
 



  
 



**Nice to have** 




 • GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD or Flux.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**DevOps Engineer**
Experience: 1–5 Years \| Location: Hyderabad (Onsite)
About SmartDocs SmartDocs is an AI\-powered Source\-to\-Pay platform helping enterprises digitize and automate their procurement and finance operations. As we scale our platform, we're building a strong DevOps function to keep our infrastructure fast, secure, and reliable.
The Role
You've moved past "I followed the runbook" and you're now at "I wrote the runbook, and then improved it." This role sits between our Jr. DevOps Engineer and our DevOps Manager/Lead — you're not new to this, but you're not running the whole show either. You take ownership of real pipelines, real environments, and real incidents, with a manager who trusts you to make the call and only wants to hear about it if it's actually on fire.
What You'll Actually Be Doing* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for trunk\-based development, working directly with development teams across time zones.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications on Azure (AKS preferred) — you're comfortable enough with Docker and Kubernetes that "just restart the pod" isn't your only move.
* Design and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) — provisioning, environment consistency, and cleaning up the drift nobody wants to own.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as part of your actual daily workflow — not a novelty, a habit. Scripting, troubleshooting, and automation should be faster because of it.
* Operate production MongoDB — routine administration, backup/restore testing, and enough comfort with Mongo Atlas to not panic during a replica set election.
* Implement and maintain monitoring and centralized logging (Datadog, Site24x7, ELK, Splunk, or similar) so problems get caught before clients notice them.
* Take a share of the on\-call rotation and run incident response for your piece of the system — writing postmortems that name the actual cause.
* Support security hygiene — patching, secrets, certificates, vulnerability follow\-up — and help produce evidence for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR audits when asked.
* Manage the unglamorous but critical stuff: domain/DNS (Cloudflare/GoDaddy), version control hygiene, ticket discipline in Jira.


Who We're Looking For* 1–5 years in DevOps/SRE/infrastructure roles, with real production ownership — not just POCs and sandbox environments.
* Solid Azure fundamentals: compute, networking basics, IAM, cost visibility. AWS/GCP exposure is a plus, not a substitute.
* Hands\-on with Docker and Kubernetes in a real deployment context.
* Working CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Bitbucket CI/CD.
* Comfortable with Python or Bash for automation — you'd rather write a script than repeat a manual step three times.
* Some exposure to MongoDB administration; Mongo Atlas familiarity is a plus.
* Familiarity with Git\-based version control and ticketing tools (Jira or similar).


Must\-Have (Non\-Negotiable)* Practical, current fluency with AI\-assisted development tools — Claude Code specifically preferred, GitHub Copilot or equivalent acceptable. If you haven't used one to actually get work done faster, this isn't the right seat yet.
* Genuine curiosity about how AI tooling changes DevOps work — we're an AI company, and we expect that to show up in how you work, not just what you build.


Why SmartDocs
You'll get real ownership of pipelines and environments that matter, mentorship from a manager who's actually run production, and room to grow into more scope as you prove it out. Fast\-growing AI product company, real infrastructure problems, no busywork theater.

title: Senior Associate -DevOps
description:
### **Description**

  

The Knowledge Manager owns the operational governance and full lifecycle of IT knowledge used by the Service Desk, resolver teams and end users. Reporting to the Senior Lead Associate \- Service Desk and Knowledge Management, the role converts technical and operational expertise into accurate, searchable, reusable and user\-friendly content.  

The role works across Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management to embed knowledge capture and reuse into day\-to\-day practices, strengthen first\-contact resolution and improve self\-service. This is an individual\-contributor role; Service Desk leadership, staffing, escalation ownership and strategic direction remain with the Senior Lead Associate.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Execute and continually improve the Knowledge Management roadmap under the direction of the Senior Lead Associate.
* Maintain KM policies, standards, article templates, ownership models, approval workflows and review schedules.
* Govern the complete article lifecycle, including creation, validation, publication, review, update, archive and retirement.
* Maintain taxonomy, metadata, naming and tagging standards to improve findability and consistency.
* Coordinate knowledge health reviews and remediate stale, duplicate, inaccurate or low\-value content.
* Embed knowledge capture, reuse and improvement into Incident, Request, Problem and Change workflows.
* Facilitate knowledge harvesting after major incidents, recurring incidents, problem investigations, releases and significant changes.
* Work with Service Desk analysts, subject matter experts, resolver groups and service owners to capture and validate solutions.
* Ensure known errors, workarounds and standard resolutions are converted into governed knowledge where appropriate.
* Support operational readiness by ensuring new or changed services have approved support knowledge before go\-live.
* Apply Knowledge\-Centred Service principles and coach authors, reviewers and approvers on contribution behaviours and quality standards.
* Curate clear, task\-based content for self\-service and approved support channels.
* Use search results, user feedback and ticket trends to identify content gaps and improvement priorities.
* Administer and improve ServiceNow KM workflows, including templates, approvals, feedback and lifecycle controls.
* Identify automation opportunities for classification, tagging, review reminders, duplicate detection and content recommendations.
* Support controlled use of AI\-assisted knowledge capabilities with human review and governance.
* Maintain measures for article quality, freshness, reuse, findability, contribution and self\-service success.
* Produce regular KM reporting and maintain a prioritised improvement backlog for the Senior Lead Associate.

**Experience \& Education\**** Mandatory total professional experience: 7 to 12 years.
* Mandatory relevant experience: 4 to 7 years in Knowledge Management, KCS, ITSM knowledge governance, technical content governance or a related discipline.
* Practical experience in an IT Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* Hands\-on experience managing knowledge in ServiceNow Knowledge Management or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience improving KM governance, workflows, taxonomies, article standards and review controls.
* Experience integrating knowledge activities with Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management.
* Experience using reports and analytics to identify knowledge gaps and drive continual improvement.
* Experience facilitating knowledge\-harvesting sessions and coaching contributors.
* Minimum education: Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* Desirable: experience with KCS maturity, self\-service portals, enterprise search, chatbots, virtual agents, ServiceNow AI capabilities or global shared services.

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Strong understanding of ITIL 4 Knowledge Management and its relationship with Service Desk and core ITSM practices.
* Practical knowledge of KCS principles, knowledge lifecycle governance and content quality controls.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, article structures, workflows and reporting.
* Ability to design and maintain taxonomies, metadata, tagging structures and content templates.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into concise and audience\-appropriate content.
* Strong analytical skills across search, usage, quality, feedback and operational data.
* Strong facilitation, coaching and stakeholder\-influencing skills without direct reporting authority.
* Sound understanding of accessibility, version control, auditability and responsible AI governance.

**Essential requirement (non\-negotiable) \**** Total professional experience within the 7 to 12\-year range.
* Minimum 4 years of directly relevant Knowledge Management, KCS or ITSM knowledge\-governance experience.
* Hands\-on ServiceNow Knowledge Management or comparable enterprise ITSM knowledge\-platform experience.
* Practical experience in a Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Strong written communication and ability to simplify technical information.
* Ability to work the stated UK shift from Pune.

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise\-scale CI/CD, release management, cloud infrastructure, and platform engineering solutions for highly available, mission\-critical software products.
   

  

 You will lead the build and release strategy while providing hands\-on implementation for complex, large\-scale, and concurrent software releases across multiple environments. Working closely with Engineering, Platform, Security, and Operations teams, you will drive automation throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), enabling continuous integration, testing, deployment, and delivery of high\-quality software.
   

  

 This role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, DevSecOps, observability, and modern software delivery practices. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of concurrent software development, build and release management, environment strategy, and platform reliability. You will play a key role in building resilient, scalable, secure, and highly available platforms that accelerate innovation and support business growth while promoting engineering best practices and operational excellence.
   

  

 tex
   

  

**Job Description**
**Core Responsibilities**
* Own the strategy, design, implementation, and support of CI/CD, build, release, and deployment processes across multiple products and environments.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or Harness.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, and Ansible.
* Implement GitOps deployment models using ArgoCD and FluxCD.
* Deploy, manage, and optimize cloud\-native applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Build and support containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Partner with Development, QA, Security, and Operations teams to streamline software delivery and platform reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated testing, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and disaster recovery mechanisms.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices including security scanning, compliance validation, secrets management, and policy enforcement into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create and maintain observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, OpenSearch, Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, and cloud\-native monitoring tools.
* Drive platform modernization, automation, cloud transformation, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI\-assisted DevOps solutions to improve engineering productivity and operational excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-8 years of experience in DevOps Role
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, and automation scripting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools including Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Bicep, and Ansible.
* Strong expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and container orchestration technologies.
* Hands\-on experience implementing GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and/or FluxCD.
* Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory, Harbor, ECR, or Azure Container Registry.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, OpenSearch, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
* Strong understanding of Linux/Unix administration, networking, security, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices including vulnerability scanning, container security, secrets management, and policy enforcement.

title: Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Ready to be a Titan?
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale.
   

  

 We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

  

* Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load).
* Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure.
* Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems.
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, MCP\-based agents). Build SRE skills to automate investigations, ship fixes across infrastructure and application repositories
* Define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship.
* Drive adoption of best practices in reliability and observability across engineering teams.
* Build and maintain automation that reduces manual, repetitive operational work across the team.
* Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

  

* Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system.
* SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions.
* Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS, GCP or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing).
* Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools.
* CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system (GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable).
* Experience building web applications on .NET stack, Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) deployed at scale
* Foundational experience supporting distributed systems and their common failure modes (retry storms, timeouts, cascading failures) at scale.
* Experience handling livesite incidents, troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure with proven ability to raise the bar and improve TTx SLA.
* Experience with AI tools (building SRE skills, root cause analysis agents deployed in production systems etc.) is required
* 10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience.


**About You**
 You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas.
   

  

 ‌
   

  

**Be Human With Us:**
 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
   

  

**Use of AI Technology:**
 We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.
   

  

 At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

 more than provision and monitor off\-the\-shelf tools from commercial vendors. **Pipeline Security Engineering** 



* Integrate static analysis, software composition analysis, secrets detection, container scanning, and infrastructure\-as\-code scanning into CI/CD pipelines across multiple product groups and build/extract out reference architectures for future reuse.

* Proficiency in designing and architecting secure systems

title: Staff Engineer, Distributed Storage and HPC & AI Infrastructure
description:
**About The Role**
 In this role, you will operate, scale, and optimize multi\-petabyte storage systems purpose\-built for the world’s largest AI training and inference workloads. You’ll manage and scale high\-performance parallel filesystems and object stores, evaluate and integrate cutting\-edge technologies such as Vast, Weka, Ceph, and Lustre, and solve the complex engineering challenges of operating at extreme throughput, low\-latency data paths, and massive cluster\-scale storage operations.
   

  

 You will also build Kubernetes\-native storage operators and self\-service platforms that provide automated provisioning, strict multi\-tenancy, performance isolation, and quota enforcement at cluster scale. Day\-to\-day, you’ll optimize end\-to\-end data paths for 10\-50 GB/s per node, design multi\-tier caching architectures, implement intelligent prefetching and model\-weight distribution, and tune parallel filesystems for AI workloads.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect and implement the technical strategy and storage roadmap for Together AI, driving high\-performance architectural decisions as we scale our GPU fleet.
* Engineer and scale multi\-petabyte AI/ML storage systems by integrating Vast, Weka, and Ceph while executing deep cost optimization through automated tiering and lifecycle policies.
* Develop intelligent caching and tiered storage architectures to achieve extreme IOPS and cluster\-wide throughput at GPU scale for training and inference workloads.
* Tune storage isolation at the L2/L3 network layers to ensure secure, production\-grade multi\-tenancy for storage clients.
* Code Kubernetes storage operators and controllers to enable automated provisioning, self\-service abstractions, and quota enforcement.
* Engineer end\-to\-end data paths to achieve 10\+ GB/s per GPU node; architect multi\-tier caching for model weights and datasets; tune parallel filesystems using advanced profiling; and scale storage infrastructure across thousands of nodes.
* Optimize end\-to\-end data paths through advanced benchmarking and profiling, contributing high\-impact code to open\-source storage projects and internal tooling.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years in storage engineering, managing distributed storage at multi\-petabyte scale
* Proven track record deploying and operating high\-performance storage for GPU/HPC clusters
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud\-native storage experience in production environments
* Strong coding skills in Go and Python with demonstrated ability to build production\-grade systems and tooling
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* History of technical leadership: designing systems that significantly improved performance, reliability (99\.999%\+ uptime), or cost efficiency
* Distributed Storage Systems: Deep expertise in either of Ceph, WekaFS, Lustre, Vast, GPFS, or similar parallel filesystems at multi\-petabyte scale
* Object Storage: Production experience with S3, MinIO, Ceph, or R2 including performance optimization and cost management
* Kubernetes Storage: CSI drivers, StatefulSets, PersistentVolumes, storage operators, and custom controllers
* Storage optimization for GPU workloads, RDMA/InfiniBand networking, parallel filesystem optimization (TB/s aggregate cluster throughput \- line saturation)
* Programming: Go and Python for automation, operators, and tooling
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps (ArgoCD)
* Linux Storage Stack: Advanced knowledge of filesystems (ext4, xfs), LVM, NVMe optimization, RAID configurations
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos architecture and operations


**Nice To Have Skills**
* GPU Direct Storage (GDS), NVMe\-oF, storage networking, RDMA implementations
* ML/AI storage patterns (model weights, checkpointing, dataset caching)
* Storage benchmarking and profiling tools (fio, iperf3, iostat, blktrace)


**About Together AI**
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

 Responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing cloud architectures across public, private, and hybrid environments. This role ensures that cloud solutions are secure, scalable, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business and enterprise architecture standards.

 Define cloud architecture solutions for complex enterprise systems

 Lead architectural decisions for cloud migrations, modernizations, and cloud\-native initiatives

 Present architectural decisions to executive and technical stakeholders

* Degree in Engineering, preferably in Information Technology.

**Relevant certifications such as:**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self\-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.

title: Senior API Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in
 **TypeScript and Python** 
 , and you will own the
 **Kubernetes** 
 deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
   

  

 These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Building Platform Capabilities**
* Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
* Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
* Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
* Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
* Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow


**Deployment \& Operations**
* Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
* Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
* Configure the API layer in front of your services: routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
* Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
* Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking


**Working in the Team**
* Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
* Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
* Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Must Have**
* 3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
* Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
* Real Kubernetes experience: you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
* Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
* CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
* Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
* Working knowledge of relational databases
* You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
* Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
* Fluent in English


**Nice to Have**
* API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
* GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
* OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
* Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
* Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
* GraphQL
* Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
* Background in financial services or another regulated industry


 Mindset
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
* Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
* Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
* Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back
* Is comfortable owning a service from the API contract through to production
* Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

 DigitalXnode works with organizations across industries to address their technology and workforce requirements. We provide recruitment and staff augmentation support by connecting businesses with professionals whose skills match their specific roles and projects. Our goal is to simplify access to relevant talent while helping professionals find meaningful opportunities across India, US, UK, Dubai and other countries.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer with 6–11 years of experience to support our client in India. The role focuses on designing, building, automating, and optimizing enterprise cloud solutions on AWS. Along with cloud infrastructure, the position involves backend development using TypeScript, distributed systems, Redis/Valkey, DynamoDB, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud monitoring.

* Build, configure, and administer AWS IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments.
* Automate cloud infrastructure and deployments using AWS CloudFormation, Lambda, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Build and maintain AWS infrastructure and support cloud migration initiatives.
* Support and troubleshoot applications hosted on AWS.
* Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using TypeScript.
* Design and work with microservices, serverless, and event\-driven architectures.
* Work with AWS services including EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway.
* Develop and maintain solutions involving Redis/Valkey and DynamoDB.
* Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate application and infrastructure delivery.
* Containerize applications using Docker and apply best practices for deployment and runtime management.Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize distributed cloud systems.
* Collaborate with engineering and technical teams to improve cloud reliability, automation, and application performance.

* 6–11 years of overall cloud, DevOps, software engineering, or enterprise technology experience.

* 5\+ years of hands\-on TypeScript development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway.

* Experience with AWS IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments.

* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Experience with microservices, serverless, and event\-driven architectures.
* Proficiency in Python, CI/CD, Docker, and cloud monitoring tools.

**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with Lua scripting.
* Experience with Twilio integrations.
* Exposure to FastAPI.
* Exposure to Zod or Pydantic frameworks.
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale distributed cloud environments.


 AI Experience
   

  

 AI experience is not essential for this role. The source requirements focus on AWS cloud, DevOps, backend development, distributed systems, and data services.
   

  

 Managerial Experience
   

  

 Formal people\-management experience is not specified as mandatory. Take strong technical ownership while working closely with cloud, backend, and engineering teams.
   

  

 Operational Experience
   

  

* Experience supporting and troubleshooting applications running in AWS environments.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation and migration.

**Qualifications**

**Job Description**
 ATM Switch Production Support Engineer – L2 Location Thane / Mumbai Department Technology Operations / Production Support Reporting To Service Delivery Manager / Production Support Manager Support Model 24x7 production / on\-call support Experience 3 to 6 years production support in ATM/Payment Switch Employment Type Full\-time Role Level L2 Production Support Domain ATM Switch, Cards and Payment Switching
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 The ATM Switch Production Support Engineer – L2 will be responsible for maintaining the stability, availability, performance and continuous improvement of the Bank’s ATM Switch ecosystem. The role covers L2 production support, incident and problem management, temporary and permanent fixes, defect and bug\-fix coordination, switch improvements, BCP/DR participation, monitoring enhancement, release support and process automation.
   

  

 Role Scope
   

  

 Support ATM, POS, E\-Commerce, Card Management and payment switch integrations across domestic and international card transaction flows.
   

  

 Provide L2 support for critical transaction processing across NPCI/RuPay, VISA, Mastercard, NFS, interchange and host system integrations.
   

  

 Coordinate with L1 operations, infrastructure, network, database, security, application development, vendors and business/operations teams to ensure timely service restoration and long\-term stability.
   

  

 Contribute to operational resilience through DR drills, failover/failback validation, preventive monitoring, automation and structured knowledge management.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Production Support and Service Operations


 Provide Level\-2 production support for ATM Switch, Card Management Systems, DCMS/CCMS and related channel banking applications.
   

  

 Monitor application health, transaction flows, switch queues, interface availability, host connectivity and network communication channels.
   

  

 Analyse production issues using application logs, traces, dashboards, transaction data and database queries.
   

  

 Ensure timely resolution of production incidents within agreed SLAs and operational risk controls.
   

  

* Incident Management, Temporary Fixes and Permanent Fixes


 Take ownership of P1/P2 and business\-critical incidents from L2 perspective, including diagnosis, workaround, service restoration and stakeholder updates.
   

  

 Implement approved temporary fixes to restore service quickly while ensuring operational risk is assessed and controlled.
   

  

 Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions and permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Maintain clear incident timelines, technical observations, action owners, RCA inputs and closure evidence.
   

  

* ATM Switch Improvements and Bug Fix Management


 Identify functional, technical and operational improvement opportunities in ATM Switch transaction processing, routing, authorisation, settlement and reconciliation flows.
   

  

 Internal document \| ATM Switch L2 Production Support JDThis is an Internal document.
   

  

 Track application defects, recurring bugs and product issues with internal development teams and switch vendors until closure.
   

  

 Participate in solution validation, SIT/UAT support, regression testing and production readiness checks for switch fixes and enhancements.
   

  

 Ensure bug fixes are prioritised based on business impact, risk, incident recurrence and regulatory or audit relevance.
   

  

* Problem Management and Stability Improvement


 Analyse recurring incidents, decline patterns, exception scenarios and operational trends to identify systemic issues.
   

  

 Prepare preventive and corrective action plans to improve reliability, reduce repeat incidents and improve transaction success rates.
   

  

 Work with technology teams and vendors to implement performance tuning, monitoring enhancements and reliability improvements.
   

  

 Contribute to knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks and standard operating procedures.
   

  

* Change, Release and Deployment Support


 Support production deployments, application patching, platform upgrades, switch configuration changes and release activities.
   

  

 Perform impact analysis, implementation checks, rollback planning, sanity testing and post\-deployment validation.
   

  

 Ensure changes are executed with minimal business disruption and aligned with change management governance.
   

  

* BCP, DR and Operational Resilience


 Participate in BCP/DR drills, regulatory exercises and planned failover/failback activities for ATM Switch and connected systems.
   

  

 Validate switch readiness across primary and DR environments, including application, database, interface, host and network dependencies.
   

  

 Document DR observations, gaps, action items and closure evidence to strengthen operational resilience.
   

  

 Support high availability environments and business continuity readiness for critical payment services.
   

  

* Automation and Continuous Improvement


 Identify repetitive operational activities suitable for automation, including monitoring, reporting, reconciliation checks, alert enrichment and production validation.
   

  

 Develop or support scripts, utilities and dashboards using Shell/Python/SQL or approved automation tools.
   

  

 Promote self\-healing or preventive monitoring mechanisms where feasible to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
   

  

 Measure improvement outcomes through reduced MTTR, lower repeat incidents, faster reporting and improved SLA adherence.
   

  

* Compliance, Audit and Risk Controls


 Ensure support activities comply with RBI/NPCI requirements, internal Information Security policies, operational risk frameworks and audit expectations.
   

  

 Provide evidence, technical explanations and closure inputs for internal, statutory, regulatory and information security audits.
   

  

 Track audit observations and control gaps related to ATM Switch operations until closure.
   

  

* Vendor and Stakeholder Management


 Coordinate with ATM Switch vendors, network partners, third\-party service providers and internal stakeholders for issue resolution and service improvement.
   

  

 Follow up on vendor defects, RCAs, remediation plans, patch deliveries and product\-level fixes.
   

  

 Communicate effectively during incidents, changes, releases, DR drills, audits and governance reviews.
   

  

 Internal document \| ATM Switch L2 Production Support JDThis is an Internal document.
   

  

 Technical Skills Skill Area Expected Capability ATM / Payment Switch Domain
   

  

 ATM Switch support, payment switching, card transaction processing, VISA, Mastercard, RuPay, NFS, interchange, host integration and ISO8583 messaging. Transaction Analysis
   

  

 Transaction lifecycle analysis, decline analysis, routing, authorisation, settlement, reconciliation and exception investigation. Database
   

  

 Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, complex troubleshooting queries, data validation and performance query analysis. Operating Systems
   

  

 Linux/Unix operations, shell scripting, log analysis and batch/process monitoring. Integration and Middleware
   

  

 APIs, web services, TCP/IP communication, host interfaces and network connectivity troubleshooting. ITSM and Monitoring
   

  

 ServiceNow/BMC Remedy/Jira, Grafana or equivalent monitoring, alerting, dashboarding and incident/problem/change processes. Automation
   

  

 Shell/Python scripting, SQL utilities, reporting automation and operational process optimisation. Preferred Exposure
   

  

 DevOps tools, Java application support, NPCI/VISA/Mastercard simulators, Finsim or equivalent transaction simulators.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators KPI Success Measure MTTR
   

  

 Reduction in mean time to restore/resolve incidents. Incident SLA Compliance
   

  

 Timely closure of incidents within agreed severity\-wise SLAs. P1/P2 Management
   

  

 Effective service restoration, escalation, communication, RCA and preventive action tracking. Repeat Incident Reduction
   

  

 Reduction in recurring incidents through permanent fixes and preventive controls. Switch Stability and Availability
   

  

 Improved application availability, transaction continuity and reduced business disruption. Automation Benefits
   

  

 Reduction in manual activities, faster reporting, improved monitoring and reduced operational risk. Audit and Control Compliance
   

  

 Timely closure of audit observations and adherence to regulatory/internal control requirements.
   

  

 Behavioural Competencies
   

  

 Strong analytical, diagnostic and structured problem\-solving capability.
   

  

 Calm, ownership\-driven approach during high\-pressure production incidents.
   

  

 Clear written and verbal communication with business, technology, vendor and leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 Strong documentation discipline for RCA, runbooks, SOPs, deployment records and audit evidence.
   

  

 Collaborative working style with ability to coordinate across multiple internal and external teams.
   

  

 Continuous improvement mindset with focus on resiliency, automation and operational excellence.
   

  

**Educational Qualifications And Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, MCA or equivalent technical qualification.
   

  

 3 to 6 years of production support experience, including minimum 3 years in ATM Switch or Payment Switch support.
   

  

 Experience supporting ATM, POS, E\-Commerce or card transaction processing environments in a banking, financial services or payment processing organisation.
   

  

 Preferred: ITIL Foundation certification, exposure to DR/BCP exercises, major incident management and audit/regulatory support.
   

  

 Expected Outcomes from the Role
   

  

 Stable and resilient ATM Switch production operations with faster incident restoration and reduced repeat issues.
   

  

 Structured handling of temporary fixes, permanent fixes, bug fixes and vendor/product remediation.

description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Energy Systems**
 We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Unit Description – Synergi Life**
 DNV’s Synergi Life is one of the world’s leading QHSE (Quality, Health, Safety \& Environment) and risk management software solutions, trusted globally for its ability to enhance operational safety and compliance. The platform is designed to support organizations in managing incidents, risks, audits, and sustainability initiatives through a fully integrated, user\-friendly system.
   

  

**Vision**
 To deliver a state\-of\-the\-art QHSE and Risk Management solution that combines superior usability with advanced technology, enabling organizations to achieve excellence in safety, compliance, and sustainability.
   

  

**Core Capabilities**
* Incident \& Non\-Conformance Management: Streamlined reporting and analysis to prevent recurrence and improve safety culture.
* Risk \& Barrier Management: Comprehensive tools for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across operations.
* Audit \& Inspection Management: Structured workflows for planning, executing, and following up on audits and inspections.
* Sustainability \& ESG Monitoring: Support for environmental and social governance reporting, including emissions and waste tracking.
* Analytics \& Continuous Improvement: Real\-time dashboards, KPIs, and trend analysis to drive proactive decision\-making.


**Technology Highlights**
* Cloud\-based SaaS for flexibility and scalability.
* Mobile and desktop access for real\-time data entry and monitoring.
* Modular architecture tailored to organizational needs.


**Objective**
 To empower the local unit with tools and processes that ensure compliance, reduce operational risk, and foster a proactive safety and sustainability culture.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a passionate DevOps Engineer to join our team and contribute to building world\-class, high\-performance, enterprise\-grade solutions for DNV’s products. The ideal candidate should embrace ethical values, transparency, and accountability, while being a quick learner who adapts to emerging technologies. This role requires strong technical expertise, a keen eye for quality, and a commitment to meeting deadlines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for automated builds and deployments.
* Manage and optimize Microsoft Azure resources including Azure SQL Database (Hyperscale), Blob Storage, and Active Directory / Entra ID.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Bicep for provisioning and configuration.
* Collaborate on containerization strategies using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes (future adoption).
* Configure and maintain monitoring and logging solutions such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics Workspace, Application Insights, and Nlog.
* Apply DevSecOps practices to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines and ensure compliance with encryption standards.
* Perform snapshot testing, point\-in\-time recovery, and reliability assessments to maintain system resilience.
* Work with development teams using Visual Studio Code and other tools to streamline workflows.
* Participate in Well\-Architected Reliability Assessments with Microsoft to ensure system robustness.
* Collaborate with QA teams to ensure adequate test coverage and quality gates.


 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Program)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 About you
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Electronics Engineering from an accredited institution.
* Preferred: Master’s Degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Overall 6 to 10 years of DevOPS experience
* Experience in Version Control \- Git, GitHub, CI/CD tools \- Azure DevOps (primary), Containerization \& Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (nice to have).
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (mandatory), Bicep, Ansible (nice to have).
* Experience in Monitoring \& Logging: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics (mandatory); Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack
* Familiarity with Security \& Compliance tools and practices: DevSecOps etc.
* Experience in writing script (ideally Powershell)
* Working with Azure
* Collaboration tools: ADO
* Development Tools: Visual Studio/VS\-Code
* Nice\-to\-Have Skills
* Docker Compose, KubeIT
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks (Pytest, Selenium, JMeter)


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

title: DevOps and CICD Automation Engineer
description:
The Department
   

  

 Developer Engineering is a function of the CTO organization. Our mission is to make it easy and enjoyable for software engineering teams to go from a business idea to delivering an innovative product solution. The main goals are to improve and upgrade our tools, streamline our processes, automate, and strengthen our controls, and help development teams adopt modern working methods.
   

  

 The Team
   

  

 Within the Developer Engineering department, the Developer Services group is a dedicated expert team focused on driving the everything\-as\-code agenda and delivering tangible reductions in process friction, errors, and manual effort to comply with and administer our policies, standards, and the controls that derive from them.
   

  

 Developer Services is a cross\-functional team of engineers, data scientists, business analysts, and product managers that will directly engineer new codified controls and the underlying capabilities required to support them and drive other groups to provide the automated controls.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Software Engineers and DevOps professionals are critical to building the products and services we need to deliver on our Developer Services vision. Joining us as a
 **DevOps \& CI/CD Automation Engineer** 
 , you will have the opportunity to build and enhance high\-profile automation products, work closely with a talented group of peers, and continuously expand your technical skillset. We believe that our engineers should be involved in all steps of our product lifecycle, from initial concept to execution. You will play a key role in shaping the future of developer experience and automation at Citi.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled and motivated DevOps \& CI/CD Automation Engineer to join our Developer Services group. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our next\-generation CI/CD release automation infrastructure. You will leverage Citi's strategic developer platform, and integrate cutting\-edge AI\-powered tools and GenAI APIs via Citi's GenAI Gateway to drive efficiency, enhance code quality, and automate key stages of the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical contributor with a strong background in pipeline automation, containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code, eager to drive modern engineering practices within a complex, enterprise\-scale environment.
   

  

 Core Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and maintain resilient, end\-to\-end declarative pipelines within our pipelines using Tekton (CI) and Harness.io (CD). Support the migration of legacy applications from Jenkins/RLM/uDeploy to the strategic platform.
* Automated Quality Gates \& Compliance: Integrate deterministic compliance and validation tools like Heimdall (to validate Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm configurations against Citi standards) alongside security and quality scanners (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Black Duck, and Aqua VSaaS) into the CI/CD toolchain.
* GenAI\-Powered Automation: Develop and deploy automation solutions by consuming GenAI APIs through Citi's GenAI Gateway. Integrate GenAI frameworks to automate pull request (PR) reviews, end\-to\-end (E2E) project reviews, and documentation generation.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and manage infrastructure provisioning and configuration using IaC principles and tools (Terraform, Ansible) to ensure consistent, repeatable environments across Red Hat OpenShift (Citi Enterprise Container Services \- ECS/Andromeda), AWS (EKS), and RHEL.
* Agile Development \& Collaboration: Operate as an active technical contributor within an Agile/Scrum team. Own the delivery of sprint goals, write high\-quality automation code, and participate in peer code reviews and technical design sessions.
* Tooling \& Release Management: Assist in the technical evaluation, integration, and lifecycle management of third\-party and open\-source DevOps tools. Package and deploy pipeline updates and patches to ensure optimal performance and security.
* System Diagnostics \& Troubleshooting: Apply strong analytical and diagnostic skills to identify and resolve complex issues within the CI/CD toolchain, distributed systems, and application deployments.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, or CI/CD Engineering role (or equivalent software engineering experience with a strong focus on automation).
* CI/CD Tooling: Strong proficiency with CI/CD platforms, specifically Tekton and Harness (or Jenkins and GitLab CI), and building declarative pipelines (YAML, Jenkins files).
* Scripting \& Automation: Strong scripting and programming skills in Python, Go, or Groovy for tool development and automation.
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift (Citi ECS/Andromeda).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proven experience with Terraform or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* Security \& Quality Scanning: Familiarity with integrating tools like SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Black Duck, or Aqua VSaaS into pipelines.
* Version Control \& Workflows: Mastery of Git and branching strategies, with a strong preference for trunk\-based development in enterprise environments (Bitbucket/GitHub).
* GenAI \& API Integration: Experience consuming RESTful APIs. Exposure to GenAI LLM integration or automated review frameworks is highly desirable.
* Education \& Professional Skills: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Strong problem\-solving skills, adaptability, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

+ Partner with senior executives, risk governance, and compliance stakeholders to align recovery capabilities with regulatory mandates.

* Engineering \& Operations
+ Architect, engineer, and optimize enterprise backup solutions leveraging Cohesity, Rubrik, Azure, AWS, and private cloud platforms.
+ Lead design and implementation of cyber recovery vaults, immutable backups, and clean room recovery environments.
+ Establish and enforce standards for data protection, recovery SLAs, and resilience testing across global infrastructure.
+ Drive automation, orchestration, and modernization of backup workflows to improve efficiency and reduce recovery times.

* Risk \& Compliance
+ Ensure adherence to industry frameworks (NIST, ISO, COBIT, DORA, PRA, Federal Reserve, CSA CCM, CIS Controls).
+ Partner with risk and audit teams to demonstrate compliance with financial industry regulations.
+ Lead resilience exercises, cyber recovery simulations, and regulatory reporting.


* Team \& Stakeholder Management
+ Lead and mentor engineering teams across regions, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
+ Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and cybersecurity leaders to ensure seamless recovery integration.
+ Present recovery strategies and outcomes to executive leadership and regulators.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 18\+ years in backup and recovery engineering within large enterprises, preferably financial organizations.
* Technical Expertise:
+ Deep hands\-on experience with Cohesity, Rubrik, Azure, AWS, and private cloud backup platforms.
+ Strong knowledge of backup architecture, disaster recovery, point\-in\-time recovery, cyber vault recovery, and clean room recovery.
+ Expertise in cloud and hybrid backup strategies, automation, and orchestration.

* Leadership Skills:
+ Proven track record of leading large\-scale engineering teams.
+ Ability to influence senior stakeholders and regulators with clarity and confidence.

* Certifications (preferred): TOGAF, ITIL, CCSP, Azure/ AWS Solutions Architect, Terraform, CISSP, or equivalent.


**Key Attributes**
* Strategic thinker with a process\-driven approach to resilience.
* Strong communicator with ability to translate technical recovery strategies into executive\-level narratives.
* Passion for operational resilience, cyber recovery, and regulatory compliance.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees.  Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
